nodes.title: next command: what's left to do
nodes.body:
### Context

`today` answers "what changed?", but not "what's left to do?". An open issue assigned to you with no recent movement doesn't appear in any command. `next` closes that loop: the person reads what's pending, hands the facts to their agent and continues the work, with every item linked to its source.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `gh receipts next` prints these sections: Your open PRs, Waiting for your review, Issues assigned to you
- [ ] Each open PR shows its CI state and review decision
- [ ] Each assigned issue shows how many acceptance criteria are checked (for example `2/5`), using `internal/criteria`
- [ ] An issue without acceptance criteria shows "no criteria found", never a guess
- [ ] Empty sections are hidden; if everything is empty, it prints a single "Nothing pending" line
- [ ] Every line ends with a URL — no line is printed without a source
- [ ] Sections and items follow a fixed, documented order, computed without AI
- [ ] `--json` prints the same data as JSON, including the unchecked criteria text, with a stable documented schema
- [ ] `--repo owner/name` works outside a git directory, as in `today`
- [ ] The command doesn't read or change the last session stored by `today`
- [ ] Unit tests use JSON fixtures — no network calls in tests

### Notes and hints

- Depends on: `today` command (#3) and Acceptance criteria parser (#5).
- The text report can follow `today`: short, with `--json` as the complete output for agents.
- Text from GitHub is untrusted: remove control characters from terminal output and document that agents should treat it as data.

### Out of scope

- Deciding what to work on with AI (the agent does that from the `--json` output).
- Checking criteria against evidence (that's `verify`, v0.3).
- Issues that aren't assigned to the current user.

nodes.title: health command with team-level flow signals
nodes.body:
### Context

There's no magic formula for "is our workflow healthy?", but a few signals inspired by DORA metrics show when the flow is getting stuck. These are team-level signals, calculated directly from the API — no AI involved.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `gh receipts health` reports, for the last 14 days (configurable with `--days`):
  - [ ] median PR size (additions + deletions)
  - [ ] median time from PR opened to first review (excluding the author and bots)
  - [ ] median time from PR opened to merged
  - [ ] open PRs with no activity for more than 2 days, with links
  - [ ] issues opened vs. closed per week
- [ ] Each metric shows how many PRs or issues it was computed from
- [ ] Thresholds are configurable in `.github/receipts.yml`; defaults and the reasoning behind them are documented
- [ ] Only team-level aggregates are shown — no per-person breakdown or ranking
- [ ] Metric calculations are pure functions, unit tested with fixtures
- [ ] `--json` output is supported

### Notes and hints

- Trunk-based development favors small PRs and short-lived branches; use that to justify default thresholds.
- Depends on: Activity data layer (it may need a variant that fetches a time window instead of "since").

### Out of scope

- Deployment frequency and change failure rate (need deployment data; consider later).
